description: Fetch up to 10 URLs from an authorized sitemap and return Markdown-ish text per page in one paid call. No JS rendering. Costs $0.2 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
